text: The stomach, however, merely ridiculed the silliness of the members, who appeared not to be aware that the stomach certainly does receive the general nourishment, but only to return it again, and redistribute it amongst the rest. Such is the case," he said, "ye citizens, between you and the senate. The counsels and plans that are there duly digested, convey and secure to all of you, your proper benefit and support."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Menenius Agrippa
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
